concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-web-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured Web Component guide for versioned Sessions/own-button and /payments gift-card balance, order and partial-payment flows; source flags incomplete sample code and provider-dependent test/live setup.
warnings: Sessions v5.18+, own Pay button v5.21+, and /payments or pre-v5.18 paths have different callbacks; do not merge partial-payment semantics.
Own-button and /payments JavaScript snippets are incomplete, and Sessions mount examples differ in availability-check pattern.
Test amount suffixes are simulator results; live use requires provider onboarding, live variant addition and Support setup.
